key_message: Ground a modernization plan in evidence –
then confirm priorities with delivery and operations owners.
title: Four questions to shape a modernization plan
business_outcome_bullets: Define priority services and customer needs.
Agree baseline measures and accountable owners.
application_estate_bullets: Map application dependencies and technology health.
target_option_bullets: Compare retain, remediate, replatform, and rebuild.
delivery_readiness_bullets: Confirm delivery capacity and decision cadence.
Plan sequencing, governance, and operational ownership.
